critical_code_review_comments: LoginPage.js line 152 env-gate is correct — process.env.REACT_APP_SHOW_QUICK_LOGIN === 'true' is strict string compare. Production deploy MUST omit this variable (or set to anything other than the literal 'true') to hide the quick-login panel. Recommend documenting this gate in deployment runbook.

AuthForm.js is well-structured: htmlFor/id pairs, proper autoComplete switching by mode (new-password vs current-password), Loader2 spinner with aria-busy is exemplary a11y. minLength=6 mirrors backend validation.
Loading button text uses German ellipsis char '…' (U+2026) not '...' — correct typography choice.
Quick-login flow takes 0.42s end-to-end which is excellent (well under 5s SLO).
Password not leaked in localStorage — auth state stored only in httpOnly cookie + JWT token (not the raw password). Validated by inspecting localStorage after both register and login flows.
